english.note: 阿爸阿媽 means mom and dad.

exampleSentences.english: Did I invite you to go? My dad invited me to go too.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我請你去？我都係我阿爸請我去。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ceng2 nei5 heoi3 ngo5 dou1 hai6 ngo5 aa3 baa4 ceng2 ngo5 heoi3

exampleSentences.english: Then just get your dad to invite me too. Shouldn’t he treat everyone equally?
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉叫埋你阿爸請埋我去咪得囖。應該一視同仁嗎。
